column1: # VOICEVOX user dictionary source for opencode-tts-voicevox / claude-tts-speak.
# Fixes the "too many alphabets" problem: OpenJtalk's base dictionary does not
# know most dev jargon, so it falls back to spelling English letters out one
# at a time instead of reading them as a word. Each line below gives the
# correct katakana reading; --build-user-dict compiles this into a JSON file
# Columns (tab-separated -- keep real tabs, not spaces):
#   surface       exact text as it appears, e.g. "API" (case-sensitive)
#   pronunciation katakana reading only -- no romaji, no kanji
#   accent_type   mora index of the pitch drop; 0 (heiban/flat) is a safe
#                 default and used throughout below rather than guessing
#                 exact pitch accent for every entry
#   word_type     PROPER_NOUN | COMMON_NOUN | VERB | ADJECTIVE | SUFFIX
#   priority      0-10; 10 (used throughout) always wins over OpenJtalk's own
# Caution: "PR" is registered as pull request (プルリク), the only sense that
# comes up in this project's own domain (assistant replies about code). If
# this dictionary is ever reused somewhere PR could mean public relations,
